title: Launch Your Artist Merch Store In Minutes
desc: Launch an artist merch store in minutes: sign up, pick products, add your logo, set prices. Real print-on-demand products, no inventory.

sentences.text: Launch your own merch store in minutes.
No developer. No inventory. No waiting.
Step one, sign up and pick your store name.
Step two, choose your products. Tees, hoodies, mugs, posters.
Step three, drop in your logo and set your prices.
Your store gets its own address.
That looks like yourname.digitvl.com, and the address is free.
The setup is guided, and an AI can build it with you in chat.
You bring the idea. The platform does the heavy lifting.

chat.user: Dark, minimal, red and black. Hoodies and tees.
chat.ai: Done. Your draft store is ready to review.
